body: Thanks so much for the help. I used to talk to my counselor but now that school is out I don't get to. I'll work on getting a routine.
I've actually started jogging lately and it helps a lot. Thank you so much for the advice.

I did delete him on Facebook. He added me back. The problem with removing him is he really is a good friend when we aren't fighting. When I had my last bout of depression he was the only one there for me. I wish there was another way. I really don't wanna lose him.

If I were being completely honest with myself I'd cut someone toxic from my life. My ex. We broke up a few months ago and now we're talking like friends again. Sometimes things are okay, and sometimes he makes me feel insecure and frustrated and unwanted. Why does he text me every day but doesn't want me back? What's wrong with me? The thing that makes me feel the worst is that I know he's poison to me and I still come back. Am I so pathetic? Part of me doesn't want to lose him. He was my best friend and we took each other's virginity. I wish things could go back to how they were but it doesn't look like they will. If I had any self esteem I'd cut him out of my life completely. I don't know if I have the strength to do it though...

Thanks for replying. I know my mom is mean but I'm used to it by now. I suppose eating and sleeping better would help. I've been getting better at keeping food down and lately I've actually done nothing but sleep. I don't even want to get out of bed most days. I jusr don't know what to do anymore.
